resources.string: Numbers you mark as spam are rated on PhoneBlock (with the category you choose) and land on your PhoneBlock blacklist; \"not spam\" puts them on your whitelist. Removing a mark withdraws the report. Contacts and hidden numbers are never sent. Reports made offline are sent later.
PhoneBlock rejected the API key (a key that may rate numbers is needed)

PhoneBlock is a community spam list. With your API key, CallGuard can send the numbers you mark: spam as a rating (you choose the category), \"not spam\" as a legitimate number. This helps other users and adds the numbers to your personal PhoneBlock lists.\n\nOnly the number and the rating are sent, never contacts or hidden numbers. You can change this later in Databases → PhoneBlock.
